lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Tuesday's HARC hearing on the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave — a large-scale project with multiple new buildings in Backman Village that goes before a public hearing, making it a real opportunity for community input. Also Tuesday, HARC takes up accessibility renovations and a floor-area addition at two Town-owned buildings. And on Thursday, San Miguel County holds its sixth working session on the Land Use Code rewrite, focused on zoning, density, and incentives aimed at making workforce housing easier to build.

notable.stake: Public hearing on large multi-building Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave.
HARC reviews alterations and floor-area addition to two Town-owned landmark buildings.
County shapes final Land Use Code rules on zoning, density, and affordable housing incentives.
